intro: Save the world from evil Sabnack! In this Kogado Studio action puzzle, play as Alph to revive petrified allies with a crimson cloak and guide them to the magic circle.
description:
Released by Kogado Studio in 1991, this puzzle game blends strategic thinking with action. Players control the protagonist, Alph, to restore fairies turned into stone statues and guide them to magic circles to clear each stage. With paths blocked by locked doors and monsters exhibiting various behavior patterns, you must enlist petrified allies (Warrior, Mage, Thief) to form a party and break through.

Once revived by your cloak's power, fairies and party members form a formation around Alph. However, if caught on obstacles and separated from him, they revert into stone statues. Success requires leveraging this mechanic to adjust positioning while navigating toward the magic circle. Can you guide the scattered fairies across all 40 stages, revive four angels, and successfully seal Subnack once again...?
